Hi all — quick technical note ahead of the session. Thanks for confirming 2/24 11:00 PST. A few items we'd like ACME to share if available (these will make the pool-sizing discussion concrete):
- recent 7/30/90-day token/sec and concurrent request percentiles by route or workload (CSV is fine)
- peak burst size and how long bursts typically last
- SLOs you want to preserve under burst conditions (p95 latency, throughput targets)

On our side we'll bring:
- a sample pool-sizing worksheet and rule-of-thumb multipliers
- autoscaler policy options (scale reactive vs. proactive with buffer, cooldown settings)
- isolation knobs (soft limits, hard reservations, tenancy policies)

If you can drop the telemetry into the Drive link before EOD 2/23 that would be ideal. Otherwise we'll illustrate with representative numbers. Looking forward to it.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Dedicated Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
